ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

13. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Israf,extravagance 02 5.5 Dua 02 Page 11 of 73 xi 6 Muamalat 6.1 Fair treatment  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
